notes: Each prompt simulates a real user inviting Claude to generate a regression kanban. The 'expected_output' is what the file kanban.html should look like at a high level. Concrete assertions live in the per-eval eval_metadata.json files created during a benchmark run; the ones here are the high-confidence checks that don't require human judgement.

evals.name: explicit-kanban-request-en
evals.prompt: I just finished a sprint and need to hand this repo off to QA tomorrow. Can you generate a business regression test kanban — one HTML file the PM can open in a browser to see what changed and what to test? The staging URL is https://staging.example.com/ and we use a test account; the PM has the password.
evals.expected_output: kanban.html exists at repo root, contains every commit, has 8–15 business tasks, mentions the staging URL, includes Quick Start panel, no horizontal overflow at 390px.

assertions.text: kanban.html is written at the repo root
commits in the page equal `git rev-list --count HEAD`
Number of business task cards is between 8 and 15
The page mentions the user-provided staging URL
Page has zero horizontal overflow at 390px viewport
Impact filter offers exactly three options (key / support / internal)

evals.name: implicit-zh-handoff
evals.prompt: 我们小团队这两周 vibe coding 了一通，明天就要交给业务的同事做回归测试。能不能给我一个静态页面，业务的人打开就知道改了什么、该怎么测？域名 https://www.example.cn/，登录用 NextAuth + 测试账号。
evals.expected_output: kanban.html in Chinese, with the project's modules detected; staging URL shown; 8–15 中文 business tasks; impact filter labels in Chinese.

assertions.text: Type chip labels in Chinese (新增/修复/重构/...) appear in the page
Impact filter options include '重点：需要模拟用户测试'
Quick start panel mentions NextAuth + 测试账号
commit count in the page equals `git rev-list --count HEAD`

evals.name: tiny-fresh-repo
evals.prompt: I just created this repo, only a handful of commits so far, but I want to start the habit of running a regression kanban before every release. Set one up.
evals.expected_output: kanban.html for a small repo. Task design still produces a sensible 8–15-task spine even though most tasks will have 0 commits. The recent-changes panel falls back to 'no key changes' if nothing matches.

assertions.text: Number of business task cards is between 6 and 15
commit count in the page equals `git rev-list --count HEAD`
No element exceeds the viewport width at 390px

evals.name: negative-not-a-kanban
evals.prompt: Please review the auth flow in this codebase and tell me if there are any security issues.
evals.expected_output: Skill should NOT trigger. This is a code review task; vibe2test only generates regression kanbans.
